استفزوا (form X)

# اُسْتُفِزُّوا (ustufizzū) /us.tu.fiz.zuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
# اِسْتَفِزُّوا (istafizzū) /is.ta.fiz.zuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَفَزَّ (istafazza)
